fusions.name: Drop-Kicked Boulder
fusions.desc: Heaves up a boulder and kicks it at a target. It deals 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, ignores armour and throws the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Grip and Kick
fusions.desc: Grabs the target and kicks it with both hind feet, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Fury
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Weave Then Wallop
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
